title_en: Provisions on the Living Treatment of State Organ Staff During Sick Leave

articles.content_en: 1. Staff whose sick leave does not exceed two months shall be paid their original salary.

4. Cadres who participated in revolutionary work before the end of September 1949 and hold the position of Deputy Commissioner of an Administrative Office or equivalent, or are at or above administrative level 14; cadres who participated in revolutionary work before September 2, 1945 and hold the position of county magistrate or deputy county magistrate of a people's government of a county or equivalent, or are at or above administrative level 18; and staff who participated in revolutionary work before July 6, 1937, shall be paid their full salary during sick leave.
5. If the salary during sick leave is lower than 30 yuan, it shall be paid at 30 yuan; if the original salary is lower than 30 yuan, the original salary shall be paid.
6. Staff may continue to enjoy the living welfare benefits of the unit where they work during sick leave.
7. For staff to enjoy the living treatment under these Provisions during sick leave, they shall have a certificate from a medical institution and shall be approved by the competent leading organ.
8. The calculation of the length of service of staff shall be handled in accordance with the relevant current provisions of the State Council.
9. Public institutions subordinate to state organs may implement these Provisions by reference.
10. These Provisions shall be interpreted by the State Personnel Bureau.

11. These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation. The Interim Measures for the Living Treatment of Staff of State Organs During Sick Leave issued by the State Council on December 29, 1955 shall be abolished at the same time.
